title.narrative: Multiphase Program in Support of the Plan to Eradicate Extreme Poverty (PEEP)-I
Programa Multifase de Apoyo al Plan de Erradicacin de Extrema Pobreza (PEEP)-I

description.narrative: Los objetivos de la primera fase son: (i) contribuir a mejorar las condiciones de salud, alimentarias y nutricionales de la poblacin en extrema pobreza, principalmente en madres y nios y nias menores de dos aos del mbito rural e indgena, a travs de incentivos tanto a nivel de la demanda como de la oferta de servicios de salud; y (ii) fortalecer las organizaciones sociales y comunitarias como tambin la institucionalidad y capacidad de gestin del MPD.

The objetives of the first phase are: (i) contribute to the improvement of the nutritional and health conditions of the population in exteme poverty, particulary mothers and children below two years of age in rural and indigenous areas, through incentives at the demand and supply side of health services; and (ii) strengthen the social and community organizations as well as the institutional and management capacity of the Planning Ministry.
